claim: SEMI's April 2025 release implies 2023 packaging materials revenue of about US$23.5 billion (US$24.6bn / 1.047), restated down from US$25.2 billion first reported in May 2024; implied 2023 wafer fab materials (US$42.9bn / 1.033 = about US$41.5bn) is unchanged.
evidence: Arithmetic from SRC-0596: "Wafer fabrication materials revenue increased 3.3% to $42.9 billion in 2024, while packaging materials revenue grew 4.7% to $24.6 billion last year." 24.6/1.047 = 23.50; 42.9/1.033 = 41.53. Consistent with restated total US$64,994m (41.5 + 23.5 = 65.0).
notes: Inference from SRC-0596 growth rates and @r_tot23; rounding of the published growth rates gives roughly +/-US$0.05bn uncertainty. Supersedes CLM-1767 (first-reported 25.2).
